pipedrive.description: PLACEHOLDER — @anthropic-ai/mcp-server-fetch is a generic HTTP fetch server. It does NOT natively understand the Pipedrive API. To use live Pipedrive data, either: (1) Build a custom MCP server wrapping the Pipedrive REST API, or (2) Use the fetch server manually with full Pipedrive URLs. Without a custom server, commands fall back to template mode (manual data input). Set PIPEDRIVE_API_TOKEN and PIPEDRIVE_DOMAIN env vars before use.

zapier.description: PLACEHOLDER — @anthropic-ai/mcp-server-fetch is a generic HTTP fetch server. To trigger Zapier webhooks, use the fetch tool with full webhook URLs (e.g., https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/YOUR_ID/YOUR_HOOK). Without configured webhooks, automation chains operate in manual mode. Set ZAPIER_WEBHOOK_BASE env var before use.

jotform.description: PLACEHOLDER — @anthropic-ai/mcp-server-fetch is a generic HTTP fetch server. To access Jotform data, use the fetch tool with full Jotform API URLs (e.g., https://api.jotform.com/user/forms?apiKey=YOUR_KEY). Without a custom server, form data must be provided manually. Set JOTFORM_API_KEY env var before use.
